title: Mfe
description: Scaffold a new MFE app scoped to a specific shell.

shellName.description: Base name of the target shell, e.g. storefront (must already exist as apps/<shellName>-shell).
shellName.x-prompt: Which shell is this MFE for (e.g. storefront)?

name.description: MFE name, e.g. search (the app is created at apps/<shellName>-mfe-<name>).
name.x-prompt: What name would you like to use for this MFE (e.g. search)?

bundler.description: Module Federation bundler. Defaults to the target shell's own bundler.

state.description: State management option for this MFE.
